experiments.title: Identity and source continuity
assertions: Unchanged objects retain identity across snapshots and paired real exports.
Two identical occurrences remain distinct.
Duplicate/churned source IDs and split/merge lineage are explicit.
experiments.preparationNote: Native cases can execute before W2 supplies paired exports.

requiredArtifacts.appliesTo: Execution and terminal evidence validation. Case preparation can start immediately.
Paired-export identity cases only. Native identity cases can execute earlier.

experiments.title: IFC-native versus native-authoring slice
assertions: Compare both narrow approaches using the same logical wall/opening/space/type fixture.
Independent IFC checks preserve the declared IDs, properties and relationships.
Every unsupported transformation appears in an explicit loss report.

requiredArtifacts.appliesTo: Execution and terminal evidence validation. Case preparation can start immediately.
Exchange cases. No need to wait for all of EX-02.

experiments.title: Shared content and occurrence isolation
assertions: An occurrence edit leaves other instances and shared definitions unchanged.
An explicit type edit lists all affected instances.
Content deduplication does not couple future edits.

requiredArtifacts.appliesTo: Execution and terminal evidence validation. Case preparation can start immediately.

experiments.title: Independent acceptance and semantic conflicts
assertions: Desk and remote bed changes accept in either order with both deltas retained.
Different object IDs do not allow conflicting clearance occupancy.
New spatial insertions invalidate affected empty-region predicates.
Acceptance retries preserve command/payload identity and exact decision records.

requiredArtifacts.appliesTo: Execution and terminal evidence validation. Case preparation can start immediately.

experiments.title: Changed assumptions with valid geometry
assertions: Moving the destination wall rechecks the proposal's wall relationship.
Geometrically valid but intent-invalid candidates do not reuse approval silently.
Unrelated accepted changes retain approval only under declared equivalence rules.

requiredArtifacts.appliesTo: Execution and terminal evidence validation. Case preparation can start immediately.

experiments.title: Same-object field independence
assertions: Declared independent metadata edits preserve both values.
Divergent changes to the same meaning conflict.
Units, authored inputs and dependent derived values cannot merge as independent text fields.

requiredArtifacts.appliesTo: Execution and terminal evidence validation. Case preparation can start immediately.

experiments.title: Dependency evaluation and geometric references
assertions: Level/host edits record the complete evaluated dependent delta.
Failed or unresolved evaluation leaves accepted state unchanged.
Face split and reordering do not silently reattach dependants.
A bounded real-kernel case is required for any claim about B-rep reference stability.

requiredArtifacts.appliesTo: Execution and terminal evidence validation. Case preparation can start immediately.

experiments.title: Coordinates and units
assertions: Metres, millimetres, local placements, rotation and survey transforms retain declared accuracy.
Canonical hashes and tolerance-aware geometric comparisons remain distinct.
Exchange does not rewrite authoritative coordinates to match a viewer origin.

requiredArtifacts.appliesTo: Execution and terminal evidence validation. Case preparation can start immediately.

experiments.title: History across upgrades
assertions: Old immutable bytes and hashes remain retrievable.
Schema, dictionary, canonicalization and geometry-engine changes have pinned interpretation.
An upgraded reader does not silently replace a historical accepted representation.

requiredArtifacts.appliesTo: Execution and terminal evidence validation. Case preparation can start immediately.

experiments.title: Storage growth and working-set operations

Compare the baseline only within its supported bounds and record larger-case limits.
Record revision membership, retained versions, indexes and artifact growth separately.
Publish exact resource/settings/configuration bindings and raw samples.

experiments.title: Crash, retry and artifact completeness
assertions: Interrupt staging and publication without exposing an incomplete accepted revision.
Retry produces one logical acceptance and preserves evidence.
Restore to a fresh instance verifies required content and hashes.
Missing artifacts preserve the last complete usable revision.

experiments.title: Independent copies, divergence and authority
assertions: A retained project package opens without the original host's keys or authentication.
Disconnected edits preserve both branches, ancestry and evidence.
Reconciliation checks semantic conflicts and all required discipline decisions.
experiments.preparationNote: Portable package exchange is sufficient for this experiment; a full network sync service is outside scope.

experiments.title: Detailed 200,000 m² hospital database workload
assertions: Seeded category counts, relation integrity, history and query oracles pass before timing.
Run admitted reduced/full scales with detailed properties, ports, systems and parametric records.
Measure bulk readiness, isolated operations, aged mixed traffic, contention and working sets.
Report failures, latency distributions, achieved/offered load, resource peaks and capacity limits.
State that database-only synthetic results do not qualify geometry or a real hospital inventory.
experiments.preparationNote: Profile hospital-200k-v1; W4/#127 owns generation. Full measurements require exclusive resource scheduling.
